name: flat-lava-water-fizz
comment: BlockFluid.checkForHarden's fizz without hardening (BlockFluid.java:271-279: lava at metadata 5 and up next to water stays lava, triggerLavaMixEffects still runs). Flowing lava source (0,61,0) on the stone platform spreads at levels 2, 4, 6 (overworld step 2); still water placed silently at (4,61,0) and (0,61,-4) is first touched by the level-6 lava that flowIntoBlock places at (3,61,0) and (0,61,-3) (BlockFluid.onBlockAdded -> checkForHarden: fizz, no change), whose neighbour notification turns the water flowing (BlockStationary.setNotStationary). The spreading water then wraps the level-6 ring and notifies it again (more fizzes); the ring keeps the water from the level-2 and level-4 lava, so nothing hardens in 200 ticks and every fizz is this path. rng_state every tick pins the fizz draws (2 World.rand, 16 Math.random()).
